_comment: Checklist the Deal Critic uses. Triggers match on client country, industry and feature keywords (lower-case).

rules.name: GDPR (EU)
requires: Data Processing Agreement (DPA) with Standard Contractual Clauses for India access
EU data residency for production data
Right-to-erasure and data-export features
Cookie consent if there is a public website

rules.name: UK GDPR
requires: UK International Data Transfer Agreement / addendum
Right-to-erasure and data-export features

rules.name: HIPAA (US health data)
requires: Business Associate Agreement (BAA) signed before any PHI access
Encryption of PHI at rest and in transit
Audit logs of every PHI access
Role-based access control and session timeouts
HIPAA-eligible cloud services only
rules.effort_hint: Add the 'Audit logging & compliance controls' module (high) and ~10% extra QA

rules.name: PCI-DSS (card payments)
requires: Use hosted payment fields / tokenisation so card data never touches our servers (SAQ A)
No card numbers in logs
Annual PCI attestation owned by the client
rules.effort_hint: Keep scope at SAQ A; full PCI scope adds weeks

rules.name: COPPA / children's data
requires: Verifiable parental consent for users under 13
No behavioural advertising to children

rules.name: Accessibility (WCAG 2.2 AA / ADA / EAA)
requires: WCAG 2.2 AA design and testing
European Accessibility Act applies to EU consumer e-commerce since June 2025
rules.effort_hint: Add ~8-12% to UI and QA hours

rules.name: EU AI Act transparency
requires: Tell users they are talking to an AI
Log model versions and keep human oversight for consequential decisions

rules.name: LLM feature safety
requires: Prompt-injection and data-leak testing
Evaluation set and acceptance criteria agreed with client
Monthly model/API cost estimate passed to the client
rules.effort_hint: Add ~15% to the LLM module for evals and guardrails
